units.source_text: 不过，这些都是偶尔想到，顺便写下来的区区小事。

en.t: Still, these are only trifling matters that came to mind now and then and were written down in passing.

units.source_text: 只有一件事，不属于区区小事。

en.t: There was only one thing that was not a trifling matter.

units.source_text: 记得有一次，大概是从客厅，要不就是从小姐的卧房那边，突然传来了男人说话的声音。

en.t: I remember one time when, from the sitting room or perhaps from the young lady's bedroom, a man's voice suddenly came through.

units.source_text: 那声音绝不是我的客人，声音很小，小得听不清他们在说些什么。

en.t: That voice was certainly not one of my guests; it was very low, so low that I could not hear what they were saying.

units.source_text: 而且越是听不清，就越是刺激着我的神经。

en.t: And the less clearly I could hear it, the more it irritated my nerves.

units.source_text: 人虽然坐着看书，心情却焦躁起来。

en.t: Although I sat there reading, my feelings grew restless.

units.source_text: 我开始猜想，那个男人是她们的亲戚呢，还是一般的朋友。

en.t: I began wondering whether the man was a relative of theirs or simply an ordinary friend.

units.source_text: 继而又猜测起那个人是年轻人呢，还是老年人。

en.t: Then I started wondering whether he was a young man or an older one.

units.source_text: 可是，在房间里坐着是不可能知道的，

en.t: But sitting in my room, there was no way I could know.

units.source_text: 然而站起身，打开拉门看看是什么人，就更不可能了。

en.t: Yet getting up, opening the sliding door, and looking to see who it was was even more impossible.

units.source_text: 与其说我的神经在战栗，不如说掀起了汹涌的波澜，折磨着我。

en.t: Rather than merely trembling, my nerves seemed to surge in great waves and torment me.

units.source_text: 客人走后，我自然没有忘记问那个人的名字。

en.t: After the guest left, I naturally did not forget to ask that person's name.

units.source_text: 小姐和夫人的回答又非常简单。

en.t: The young lady's and her mother's answer was again extremely brief.

units.source_text: 我在她们面前露出不满的神色，

en.t: I showed my dissatisfaction in front of them,

units.source_text: 却没有追问下去的勇气，

en.t: but I did not have the courage to keep questioning them,

units.source_text: 当然也没有这个权利。

en.t: and of course I had no right to do so either.

units.source_text: 我将曾经受到的必须尊重自己人格的教育所培育的自尊心，

en.t: The self-respect fostered in me by the education I had received, which taught me that I must respect my own character,

units.source_text: 与违背这种自尊心的欲望，同时袒露在了她们面前。

en.t: and the desire that betrayed that self-respect were both laid bare before them at the same time.

units.source_text: 她们笑了起来，

en.t: They began to laugh,

units.source_text: 她们的笑是善意的呢，还是故意让我感觉是善意的？

en.t: but was their laughter kindly, or was it meant to make me feel that it was kindly?

units.source_text: 我一时分辨不出，顿时失去了内心的平静。

en.t: For a moment I could not tell, and I immediately lost my inner calm.

units.source_text: 而且事情过后，我还是会翻来覆去地琢磨，

en.t: And even after the matter was over, I would still turn it over and over in my mind,

units.source_text: 我被她们嘲笑了，多半是被嘲笑了。

en.t: thinking that they had laughed at me, that they most likely had laughed at me.
